subject: Request: AzurePoint permission for logo + short quote in Redwood case study
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Michael Barnes <michael.barnes@azurepoint.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-05T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: AzurePoint permission for logo + short quote in Redwood case study

Hi Michael —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We drafted a short customer spotlight focused on how AzurePoint reduced per-query latency on triage workflows after moving to Redwood Dedicated. Would you be able to review the attached one-pager and confirm we have permission to: 

- Use the AzurePoint logo (SVG) alongside our badge on the case study landing page
- Publish the short quote pulled from your feedback: "Redwood cut inference cost and reduced latency at scale" (we can revise wording)

Attachments: redwood-azurepoint-case-study-draft-v1.pdf, azurepoint_logo.svg

If it's easier, happy to route through your comms/legal for a quick sign-off. Ideally we publish the page next week. Could you let us know any edits or a point of contact for approvals?

Thanks —
Rachel
Rachel Kim
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0182

---
Replying on behalf of marketing: Marissa is looped for any visual/placement questions; Laura is our legal reviewer for usage language.

From: Michael Barnes <michael.barnes@azurepoint.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Chen <s.chen@azurepoint.com>
Date: 2026-07-05T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: AzurePoint permission for logo + short quote in Redwood case study

Hi Rachel —

Thanks for sending this over. The draft looks good overall. A couple quick notes from our side before we can sign off: 

1) Marketing placement: logo needs at least 24px padding on all sides and must be the full-color horizontal SVG — sending ours as an attachment.
2) Quote wording: can you change the quote to: "Redwood lowered our end-to-end inference latency and made costs predictable at scale."
3) Legal: we need a simple permission signature confirming we can publish the logo and the quote. I've CC'd Sarah (Legal) to confirm the wording and route the signature.

I'll ask Sarah to confirm by end of day tomorrow.

Best,
Michael Barnes
Director of Infrastructure
AzurePoint Health
michael.barnes@azurepoint.com
+1 (650) 555-0226

Attachments: azurepoint_brand_assets.zip (contains azurepoint_logo.svg)

From: Sarah Chen <s.chen@azurepoint.com>
To: Michael Barnes <michael.barnes@azurepoint.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-06T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: AzurePoint permission for logo + short quote in Redwood case study

Hi all —

We reviewed the draft and the requested quote. A few small legal items: 

- Please include the following attribution line under the quote: "AzurePoint Health (customer) — used with permission."
- We prefer the quote to remain non-attributable to an individual (i.e., the company quote above is fine).
- We need a one-paragraph description in the case study that does not disclose patient data or internal KPIs beyond the high-level reductions you listed.

I've attached a two-line signature page for an authorized signatory to confirm logo + quote usage. If Redwood can return that signed doc, we can provide the final signed permission within 48 hours.

Attachment: azurepoint-permission-signature-page.docx

Sarah Chen
Senior Counsel, AzurePoint Health
s.chen@azurepoint.com

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Chen <s.chen@azurepoint.com>, Michael Barnes <michael.barnes@azurepoint.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-06T12:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: AzurePoint permission for logo + short quote in Redwood case study

Sarah —

Thanks for the clear guidance. Marissa and Laura — quick asks for you both: 

Marissa: can you update the design to include the 24px padding and add the attribution line beneath the quote. I pasted the revised quote below as Michael requested.

Revised quote (to use verbatim):
"Redwood lowered our end-to-end inference latency and made costs predictable at scale."

Laura: can legal confirm the short non-disclosure-friendly blurb below is acceptable? We kept technical details high-level and removed any PHI or precise throughput numbers.

Proposed case-study paragraph: 
"AzurePoint Health migrated non-sensitive triage inference workloads to Redwood Dedicated, resulting in measurable latency and cost improvements while maintaining clinical data protections."

If that's acceptable to legal, I'll get the signature page completed and return the doc to Sarah for countersignature. Target: signed permission by EOD Friday.

Thanks —
Rachel

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Chen <s.chen@azurepoint.com>, Michael Barnes <michael.barnes@azurepoint.com>
Date: 2026-07-07T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: AzurePoint permission for logo + short quote in Redwood case study

Rachel / team —

Reviewed the proposed paragraph and the revised quote. Legal is comfortable with the language as long as we: 

- Keep the paragraph high-level (no specific throughput or anything that could be interpreted as patient data).
- Add this sentence to the bottom of the case study: "All customer names and logos used with permission; specific results are illustrative and may vary."

I've signed the attached signature page on behalf of Redwood (placeholder signatory authority). Rachel, please complete the signature fields for AzurePoint and return via the DocuSign link Sarah provided. Once we have the fully executed permission we can publish the page and deploy the visual.

Signed by: Laura Bennett
Legal Counsel, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

Attachment: redwood-signed-permission-placeholder.pdf

---
On behalf of marketing: Marissa, proceed with updates to the design and staging; coordinate final asset handoff once the signed permission returns.
